caption: The drawing depicts four circular objects arranged in a roughly square formation on a light beige background. In the upper left is a circle with a tan and brown woven border, featuring a central design that includes a pink curved shape, a blue flower, and a smaller blue motif. The upper right object is a round shape with a border of spikes or short lines radiating outward, filled with a geometric pattern of intersecting, light tan chevrons. The lower left object is a circle with a scalloped edge outlined in greenish-blue, containing an image of a pink and brown basket filled with green leaves and pink flowers in a cross-stitch style. The lower right circle has a more diffuse, greenish border with a central image of an off-white oval surrounded by green foliage and small pink dots. The objects are evenly spaced, each with unique decorative motifs and colored primarily in soft pastel and neutral shades.
title: Love Tokens
